answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a ocean as the anchor of the cost.
